title: A real function that is C¹ at a point agrees on a ball around it with a globally C¹ function
statement: Let m ∈ ℕ, g : ℝ^m → ℝ and x ∈ ℝ^m (ℝ^m = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin m)), and assume g is of class C¹ at x (ContDiffAt ℝ 1 g x). Then there are ρ > 0 and a function g̃ : ℝ^m → ℝ of class C¹ on all of ℝ^m (ContDiff ℝ 1 g̃) such that g̃(v) = g(v) for every v in the open ball B(x, ρ).
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (g : Eucl m → ℝ) (x : Eucl m), ContDiffAt ℝ 1 g x → ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ∃ g' : Eucl m → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ 1 g' ∧ ∀ v ∈ ball x ρ, g' v = g v
